scope: bounded reference automation for comprehensive anticipatory design decisions

canon.operational_rule: Observe the whole bounded system before selecting a local intervention.
Evaluate candidate behavior at system level rather than summing isolated component claims.
Prefer greater admitted outcome per bounded unit of resource, time, and irreversible commitment.
Prefer the smallest lawful intervention that changes the governing system trajectory.
Refuse candidates that silently externalize represented stakeholders or ecological consequences.

extensions.formula: O_star = Admit(O, boundary, provenance, authority, exclusions)
extensions.rule: Observation does not acquire standing or execution authority merely by being present.
One failed edge is preserved as topology and does not collapse the candidate graph.

extensions.formula: for every consequential actuation a, there exists an identity-bound receipt r
extensions.rule: Zero unreceipted actuation; only the broker may perform a declared effect.
UNKNOWN, PARTIAL_ALIVE, ALIVE, BLOCKED, BUILD_BROKEN, UNSUPPORTED, and typed REFUSED remain distinct.
A passing reference execution establishes standing only for its exact admitted subject.

autonomic_model.name: MAPE-K

phases.output: admitted observations O_star and typed refusals

autonomic_model.self_configuration: derive checks and scoring order from admitted authority
autonomic_model.self_optimization: select the lexicographically best lawful candidate
autonomic_model.self_protection: refuse ambient execution, path escape, missing provenance, and crown escalation
autonomic_model.self_healing: manufacture a repair intent; never mutate the governed subject without broker authorization

nonclaims: stakeholder completeness outside the represented boundary
